habits.boundary_condition: Treat this as a soft reusable default, not an absolute requirement unless the current request uses hard language. Do not infer destination, dates, price, balcony, ocean view, or indoor/outdoor pool type from this habit.
habits.condition: When selecting or evaluating hotel options.
habits.default_action: Prioritize hotel properties with this recreational/wellness amenity cluster and verify availability before recommending.
habits.exception_condition: If a current trip prioritizes a different tradeoff or a property lacks one of these amenities, ask whether a substitute or omission is acceptable.
habits.name: Prefer amenity-rich hotel properties with pool, hot tub, and exercise access
habits.preference_value: Prefers hotels that provide a pool, a hot tub, and a place to exercise, ideally a fitness center.
habits.rationale: All three independent hotel conversations ask for the same property-style amenity cluster: pool, hot tub, and exercise/fitness access. This supports a reusable preference for recreation-oriented, amenity-rich hotel properties.
